title: Wire MemoryIndex into search query path
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-002). MemoryIndex is fully wired and correctly maintained on CRUD, but every search method (SearchAsync, LexicalSearchAsync, SemanticSearchAsync, HybridSearchAsync, GetReverseReferencesAsync) calls _store.LoadAll() for a full linear scan. The index is maintained but never consumed. Wire ByTag/ByReference dictionaries into CreateSearchSnapshot for tag-filter narrowing. Note: Must fix P1-005 (stale index after consolidation) first or simultaneously.

Files: MemorySmith.Core/Indexing/MemoryIndex.cs, MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryApplicationService.cs
Confidence: 100%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md, council review
